name: raizen-norms
description: Settle an app one layer at a time and hold it there: app-settle for the domain, the stack, the docs/ documents, and existing code brought back onto these rules; logic-settle for the layer between database and UI; design-settle for the visual direction and DESIGN.md. Session norms, git and destructive-operation guards, and document, UI, database, application-logic and build-order rules govern every session after.

output_dir.title: Output folder
output_dir.description: Where sessions write the files they make for you - reports, spreadsheets, PDFs - in one folder per repo and per worktree. Leave empty for Downloads/Claude in your home folder.

norm_language.title: Norm: language
norm_language.description: The LANGUAGE block: chat, documents, commits and on-screen text in your language; code, file names, routes and database names in English. advice = printed but not binding, off = not printed.

norm_pointers.title: Norm: pointers
norm_pointers.description: The POINTERS block, or NOT SETTLED where app-settle has not run: which rule skill to read before UI, SQL, queries or documents. advice = printed but not binding, off = not printed.

norm_scope.title: Norm: scope
norm_scope.description: The SCOPE block: only what was asked - no refactor, rename or document nobody requested. advice = printed but not binding, off = not printed.

norm_git.title: Norm: git
norm_git.description: The GIT block: fetch and check the branch first, commit each finished item with named paths, push or merge only on your yes in chat. Leaves guard_git as it is. advice = printed but not binding, off = not printed.

norm_asking.title: Norm: asking
norm_asking.description: The ASKING block: your decisions are asked, and the session runs commands itself instead of handing them to you. advice = printed but not binding, off = not printed.

norm_decisions.title: Norm: decisions
norm_decisions.description: The DECISIONS block: an answer with two or more decisions closes with one table - options, and a recommendation with its trade-off. advice = printed but not binding, off = not printed.

norm_closing.title: Norm: closing report
norm_closing.description: The CLOSING THE SESSION block, in a settled repo: a report per scope item, then a fixed block - routes, defaults decided, unfinished steps, branch and commits. advice = printed but not binding, off = not printed.

norm_output.title: Norm: output folder
norm_output.description: The OUTPUT block: files made for you go to this session's folder in the output folder, named without a date, never overwritten. Leaves guard_output as it is. advice = printed but not binding, off = not printed.

guard_git.title: Guard: git
guard_git.description: Refuses git add -A, a bare force push and a commit on main; holds git push and gh pr merge until your yes in chat. advice = lets the call through and warns the session, off = does nothing.

guard_destructive.title: Guard: destructive SQL
guard_destructive.description: Refuses DROP, TRUNCATE, DELETE, a rename or an UPDATE with no narrow WHERE unless it runs inside a guard holding the row count you approved. advice = lets it through and warns the session, off = does nothing.

guard_output.title: Guard: output folder
guard_output.description: Refuses a file written to the root of the output folder, or into a folder there that is not the session's own. advice = lets it through and warns the session, off = does nothing.

remind_docs.title: Reminder: documents after a commit
remind_docs.description: After a commit that changed no document, asks the session whether one became false. off = never asks.

remind_context.title: Reminder: context size
remind_context.description: At the first commit past 200k, 500k or 800k tokens of context, the session tells you the next item costs less in a new session. off = never says it.
